displayName: SafeRoute staging: search provider is failing

documentation.content:
More than 5 failed calls to the geocoding provider within 10 minutes, counted from the API's own log lines (the logs-based metric search_provider_errors). Users see "search unavailable" (503).

What to do: docs/runbooks/alerts-staging.md, section "When an alert arrives". Do not paste project ids, URLs or tokens when asking for help.
